Rule.name: FSGov-BeforeProvisioning
Rule.Description: Prepares the plan for the legacy file system connector: 1. Account Delete becomes removal of every governed group. Legacy hosts keep the POSIX account so file ownership by uid stays resolvable for audit. 2. Group values outside the entitlement catalog are dropped and recorded. 3. Remove requests are ordered before Add requests within each account request, so the connector receives revocations first.

Argument.name: plan
Argument.Description: ProvisioningPlan about to be sent to the connector.
